attachments.displayName: FREEDOM BOARD / CORTEX M0+ GETTING STARTED | Freescale Community

object.content: I'm taking my senior design course now and I'm enrolled in the microcontroller section of it. We're using a $13 Freescale board (http://www.freescale.com/webapp/sps/site/prod_summary.jsp?code=FRDM-KL25Z) to do our main project in this course, and my professor is uploading how-to videos for this board onto YouTube so we can learn on our own pace outside of class. I figure I'll share the link with everyone in case they'd like to follow along, because the videos do a really good job of explaining everything from a really simple standpoint and it would be great for some other people outside of the class to take advantage of it. His getting started videos are located right here: https://community.freescale.com/docs/DOC-93960 If anyone decides to learn this board, let me know. I'd like to see what kind of projects you could get going.
